facts.title: pressure release during an intrusive maintenance task on PSV-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-7104 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-7104 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-7104 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-7104 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 20 April 2021 an incident occurred on PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
